topic: The Recall step only shows defaults
detail: SP-052's Recall step shows the design's safe defaults per content kind (store, auto-recall, search, queued tasks) for reading only: the policy has no per-kind rules until the chat connectors (SP-060). The table was not checked against what orch recalls today for each kind (for example whether session transcripts are auto-recalled). Proposed: verify it, and make it editable once SP-060 adds per-kind rules.
